etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 暴 'violent' (phonetic バク) — fire let loose all at once: to explode.
mnemonic: 暴 with a lit fuse — バク. 爆発: the loudest kanji in the set; 爆笑: laughter at the same yield.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 几 (phonetic キ) — the body's surface: skin, and the feel of any surface.
mnemonic: What the world touches first — はだ. 肌寒い: when air and skin disagree.

etymology: Phono-semantic: the long-hair radical (髟) + a phonetic (友-form) — the hair of the head.
mnemonic: The kanji wearing its own wig — かみ. 髪を切る: the monthly harvest.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 拔): hand (扌) + a phonetic — pulled clean out: to extract, omit, surpass.
mnemonic: One firm tug and it's free — ぬく. 手を抜く: extracting your effort; 追い抜く: extracting yourself past someone.

etymology: Compound: the boat (舟) poled around (殳) — carrying about; spread to all sides: general, sundry.
mnemonic: The ferry that serves every dock — ハン. 一般: the general public, all aboard.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 反 'turn over' (phonetic ハン) — goods turned over for cash: to sell, deal.
mnemonic: Flip the stock, pocket the difference — ハン. 自動販売機: the flip, automated on every corner.

etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — the one over there, a walk away: that; in modern Japanese, he (彼) and she (彼女).
mnemonic: The person on the far sidewalk — かれ. 彼女: 'that woman over there' turned into 'girlfriend' — Japanese romance in one etymology.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — worn down to the hide: exhausted.
mnemonic: Nothing left under the skin — つかれる. お疲れさま: the national password at day's end.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — thrown over one: to cover; what falls on one: to suffer, incur; grammar's passive marker.
mnemonic: The blanket you didn't ask for — こうむる. 被害: what landed on you; 被る: wearing it anyway.

etymology: Pictograph: bolts of cloth folded in pairs — a matched measure: an equal; the counter for small animals.
mnemonic: Small creatures counted like bolts of cloth — ひき. 犬一匹, 猫二匹: the pet census.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 布 (phonetic フ) — the heart under a thrown cloth: dread, fear.
mnemonic: The sheet over the mirror at night — こわい. 怖い: the kanji children spell with their faces.

etymology: Compound: the sun (日) shining on all alike (並) — everywhere the same: universal, ordinary.
mnemonic: One sun, no favorites — フ. 普通: the grand cosmic word for 'normal'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 孚 (phonetic フ) — held up on the surface: to float; unmoored: fickle (浮気).
mnemonic: A hand keeping the child's chin above water — うく. 浮気: a heart floating off its mooring.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 付 (phonetic フ) — the split bamboo tally whose halves match: a token, a mark.
mnemonic: The half that proves you're you — フ. 切符: the token that rides trains.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a tiger-crowned phonetic + flesh — the body's outer layer, formally: skin.
mnemonic: 肌's formal twin, wearing a tiger hat — フ. 皮膚科: where skin gets its paperwork.

etymology: Compound: the sleeved dancer (無's original picture) given feet (舛) — the borrowed dancer danced again: to dance.
mnemonic: 無 got its body back and its feet — まう. 舞台: the stage; お見舞い: dancing attendance on the sick.

etymology: Compound: earth mounded (圭) by hand (寸) at the border — territory sealed off: to seal, enfeoff.
mnemonic: Press the mound of wax down firm — フウ. 封筒: the envelope, sealed by descent.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 畐 (phonetic フク) — the bolt's full breadth: width; the counter for hanging scrolls.
mnemonic: How far the cloth reaches unrolled — はば. 道幅: the street measured shoulder to shoulder.

etymology: Simplified from 拂: hand (扌) + a phonetic — sweeping away: to brush off; sweeping money across the counter: to pay.
mnemonic: Flick it off the palm — はらう. 支払い: dust and debts, same gesture.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 弗 (phonetic フツ) — water in revolt: to boil, seethe.
mnemonic: The pot arguing with its lid — わく. お湯が沸いた: teatime's starting gun.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 辟 (phonetic ヘキ) + earth (土) — rammed earth standing up: a wall.
mnemonic: The problem you can lean on — かべ. 壁にぶつかる: progress meeting architecture.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — the hand closing on the runner: to catch, arrest.
mnemonic: Fingers close, chase over — つかまえる. 逮捕: the formal grip.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 (phonetic ボ) + strength (力) — calling strength in from far and wide: to recruit, solicit.
mnemonic: Posters in every field at dusk: hands wanted — つのる. 募集中: the kanji on the shop door.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 包 'wrap' (phonetic ホウ) — arms wrapped around: to embrace, to hold (ideas and babies alike).
mnemonic: The hand-powered version of 包 — だく, かかえる. 抱きしめる: wrapping with intent.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — the temple ward and its resident monk; affectionately, any little boy (〜坊).
mnemonic: The little monk of the household — ボウ. 赤ん坊: the newest resident; 寝坊: his favorite sin.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 冒 'covering the eye' (phonetic ボウ) — cloth over the head: a hat.
mnemonic: The cloth that shades the 冒's eye — ボウ. 帽子: sold one floor below 靴.

etymology: Compound: heart (忄) + 亡 'lost' — the heart gone missing in the rush: busy.
mnemonic: The kanji admits it: busyness is a lost heart — いそがしい. 忙しい: read the parts and wince.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 麻 (phonetic マ) + stone (石) — worked against stone: to grind, polish.
mnemonic: Stone plus patience — みがく. 歯を磨く: the twice-daily polish.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 里 (phonetic マイ) — put under the ground: to bury, fill in.
mnemonic: The village under the soil line — うめる. 埋める: holes, schedules, silences.

etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 民 (phonetic ミン) — the eye closed down: to sleep.
mnemonic: The whole population of you, eyes shut — ねむる. 眠い: the 3 p.m. kanji.

etymology: Compound: woman (女) + 良 'good' (phonetic) — the good young woman of the house: daughter.
mnemonic: 女 plus 良: the house's pride — むすめ. The kanji every father agrees with.

etymology: Compound: turning back at the door (戸) — coming back the way one went: to return, restore.
mnemonic: U-turn on the doorstep — もどる. 払い戻し: money making the same U-turn.

etymology: Simplified from 與: many hands passing something together — to give, grant, take part.
mnemonic: Handed across with a hook so it can't drop — あたえる. 給与: bestowal, salaried.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 容 (phonetic ヨウ) — taken into the liquid: to dissolve, melt.
mnemonic: The sugar accepts the invitation — とける. 溶ける: ice cream's one-act tragedy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 甬 (phonetic ヨウ) — feet springing up: to dance, leap.
mnemonic: Feet with a geyser under them — おどる. 盆踊り: the whole town's feet agreeing.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 束 (phonetic ライ) + head (頁) — leaning one's head on another: to rely, entrust, request.
mnemonic: Handing your bundle to someone and your worries with it — たのむ. 頼りになる: the shoulder that holds.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 各 (phonetic ラク) — threads wound around each other: to entangle; lines kept between people: contact.
mnemonic: Your thread looped through theirs — からむ. 連絡して: keep the loop alive.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 立 (phonetic リュウ) — one grain standing alone: a grain, a droplet, the counter for tiny things.
mnemonic: One grain at attention — つぶ. 一粒: rice, tears, and vitamins all counted alike.

etymology: Pictograph: a swaddled child, arms bound — wrapped up: finished, understood.
mnemonic: Wrapped, tied, done — リョウ. 終了 and 了解: the kanji that ends screens and radio calls.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 京 (phonetic リョウ) — the cool of water in the air: refreshing.
mnemonic: The breeze off the palace moat — すずしい. 涼しい: August's most wanted adjective.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — treatment applied to the sickbed: to heal.
mnemonic: Light brought to the bedside — リョウ. 治療: the sickbed's exit plan.

etymology: Compound: water (氵) + 戻 'turning back at the door' — the water of turning back: tears.
mnemonic: Water at the doorway of goodbye — なみだ. 涙: the kanji at every train-platform scene.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rain (雨) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — the last drops falling away to nothing: to dwindle: zero.
mnemonic: Rain ordered to stop: none left — レイ. 零点: the score with weather in its history.

etymology: Phono-semantic: teeth (歯) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — age read from the teeth, as with horses: one's years.
mnemonic: Count the teeth, name the years — レイ. 年齢: the dentist's guess, made official.

etymology: Simplified from 戀: a heart (心) caught in tangled threads — longing that binds: romantic love.
mnemonic: The heart, gift-wrapped in knots it tied itself — こい. 恋人: the person holding the other end.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a 'bent bow' phonetic (ワン) — the coast bent like a bow: a bay.
mnemonic: The shoreline drawn back like a bowstring — ワン. 東京湾: the bow aimed at the Pacific.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 宛 (phonetic ワン) — the bending limb: the arm; what arms learn: skill.
mnemonic: The limb that carries your craft — うで. 腕がいい: praise aimed at the arm, meant for the whole person.
